text_en: Explaining the verse, “say ; You have no faith, but you only say : We have submitted our wills to Allah”, Al-Zuhri said : We think that ISLAM is a word, and faith is an action.
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Muhammad bin Ubaid] berkata, telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ibnu Tsaur] dari [Ma'mar] ia berkata; [Az zuhri] berkata tentang firman Allah: '(katakanlah (kepada mereka): 'Kamu belum beriman, tetapi katakanlah, 'Kami telah tunduk\
